context: M10 o6. The Shamrock Rail at 07:30, chairs still on tables. Mayhew counts envelopes on the bar.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Flowers, wigs, Earl. Look at you, kid. A natural.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Hold on. July Fourth. The Moore woman. Fifty short.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I told you. I lost it running. Lonnie's boys.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Lost it. Sure. I'll make it up out of your next week. Like a bank.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Two hundred. And here's the list for next week. The furs are on it. Easy people.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: And kid? Wurtz asked about you. Means you're doing fine. Keep doing fine.
